characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Muk is a sludge-type Pokémon that fights by covering opponents in toxic waste and utilizing physical poison attacks. Its body is composed of hazardous, foul-smelling slime that naturally deters physical contact.

mechanisms: Poison touch body that naturally repels physical attackers
High special defense and HP pool

limitations: Vulnerable to ground and psychic maneuvers

sources.supports: General information, abilities, moveset, and typing of Muk.

feats.claim: Emits such a heavy stench that it causes nosebleeds and can wither plants simply by passing near them.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

unknowns: Exact chemical composition of its toxic secretions varies between organic waste sources.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Sun and Moon / Generation VII games
characters.summary: Alolan Muk is a Poison/Dark-type variant that consumes garbage, altering its coloration and developing toxic crystals on its body. It fights by striking with these venomous crystals and using bite attacks.

mechanisms: Toxic crystal armor that deflects or poisons attackers

characters.formDifferences: Changes typing from pure Poison to Poison/Dark, adds toxic crystal structures on its body, alters coloration, and changes immunities/weaknesses.

sources.supports: Alolan Muk regional variant details, typing, and abilities.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how it processes artificial trash into non-foul-smelling crystal toxins.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Nidoking is a powerful Poison/Ground-type brawler that uses its thick tail, immense physical strength, and a wide array of elemental moves to overwhelm opponents.

mechanisms: Heavy hide serving as physical armor

limitations: Vulnerable to water, ice, ground, and psychic elements.

feats.claim: Can topple a metal transmission tower with a single swing of its thick tail.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

unknowns: Limits of its tail strength against reinforced magical structures.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Nidoqueen is a robust Poison/Ground-type Pokémon equipped with a scaly, defensive hide and exceptional maternal combat instincts, using body slams and earth tremors to fight.

mechanisms: Armored, needle-free scaly hide designed for protecting its young

limitations: Vulnerable to water, ice, ground, and psychic attacks.

sources.supports: Nidoqueen stats, moves, and defensive traits.

feats.claim: Uses its rugged body to shield its offspring from any attack without flinching.

unknowns: Exact maximum weight it can lift with body slams.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Nidoran♀ is a small, quadrupedal poison-type rodent that uses small horns and venomous barbs to defend itself against predators.

mechanisms: Small size and quick reflexes to dodge attacks

limitations: Low physical strength compared to evolved forms.

sources.supports: Nidoran female basic information and moveset.

feats.claim: Possesses a small horn that secretes a powerful venom capable of fatal outcomes if injected.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Nidoran♂ is a small, aggressive poison-type creature that uses its large ears to sense danger and a toxic horn to jab opponents.

mechanisms: Large sensitive ears used to detect hidden foes before attacks occur

sources.supports: Nidoran male attributes and combat style.

feats.claim: Stiffens its large ears to listen for danger while keeping its horn aimed at potential threats.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Nidorina is the middle-evolution female Nidoran, utilizing its horn and claw attacks alongside a gentle temperament that turns fierce when cornered.
limitations: Moderate reach and limited ranged options.

feats.claim: Its horn retracts when it is feeling calm or friendly, and extends when preparing for battle.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Nidorino is an aggressive middle-evolution male Pokémon that fights fiercely with an exceptionally hard horn that can pierce diamond.

mechanisms: Sturdy hide and aggressive counter-attacking posture

limitations: Prone to reckless charges if angered.

feats.claim: Has a horn that is harder than a diamond, capable of shattering boulders upon impact.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games
characters.summary: Ninetales is a mystical, fox-like Fire-type Pokémon that commands intense flames, creates illusory psychics attacks, and fights with nine magical tails.
limitations: Vulnerable to water, ground, and rock moves.

sources.supports: Ninetales stats, fire abilities, and lore.

feats.claim: Can curse anyone who grabs one of its nine tails with a thousand years of hardship.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Commands intense fire blasts and flamethrowers from its mouth.

unknowns: Exact duration and mechanism of the legendary curse.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Sun and Moon / Generation VII games
characters.summary: Alolan Ninetales is an Ice/Fairy-type regional variant that lives on snowy mountain peaks, firing freezing blizzards and manipulating ice crystals to disorient adversaries.

mechanisms: Snow cloak and veil barriers reducing incoming damage

characters.formDifferences: Changes typing from Fire to Ice/Fairy, replaces fire abilities with ice and fairy maneuvers, and alters weaknesses.

sources.supports: Alolan Ninetales typing, moves, and ice-based variants.

unknowns: Exact temperature minimums of its generated ice storms.
